name: Bennet Pike
source_profile:
Engineer-Major Bennet Pike: “Ol’ Crowbar” (CN) 
Bennet Pike was once the chief engineer of a northern siege 
regiment, 
celebrated 
for 
bringing 
down 
supposedly 
impregnable fortifications during the civil war. Pike has never 
considered himself a patriot. He fought for the northern lords 
because they paid him, and he kept fighting because he was 
exceptionally good at it. After the war, he gathered surviving 
engineers, sappers, alchemists, and artillerymen into a small 
mercenary company. 
Pike has been accused of collapsing mines, destroying bridges, 
and sabotaging entire settlements at the request of wealthy patrons. He maintains that his 
company merely provides professional engineering services, and that responsibility for their 
application rests with the client. 
Reputation: Old Crowbar is infamous for declaring that no wall, bridge, or fortress in Cador is 
beyond his ability to destroy. 
Adventure hook: A newly discovered silver mine collapses, trapping dozens of workers 
underground. Evidence suggests deliberate sabotage, and several witnesses claim that 
members of the Crowbar Company were seen inspecting the mine days earlier.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 37–37 (source excerpt)
